scopeDecisions.recommendation: Assign Auth state changes to AUTH-FS-CROSS; keep static two-principal cases 108/108C and initial unauthenticated refusal 106N here. Static cross-tenant listener authorization is covered by FS-RULES/tenant together with case 108.

scopeDecisions.recommendation: Keep direct gRPC raw resume-token behavior as a separate condition; SDK-managed resume cannot establish it.
Keep real browser tab lifecycle as a separate condition because the 18-case browser shadows do not close or reload a tab.

scopeDecisions.recommendation: Run the native gRPC Listen programs (native-target-protocol, raw-resume-token, existence-filter-reconnect, and FS-TRANSACTION/commit-atomic-visibility) on fireemu-oracle-txn with the owner access token. An IAM-authenticated Listen is not subject to Rules, so no Rules release is needed there. The Node SDK, browser and Auth-dependent recordings stay on fireemu-oracle-query/(default) under the deployed Rules (OL-3).

Use the AUTH-FS-CROSS stage-2 fixture (conformance/auth-fs-cross-stage2-production.json, two production recordings on fireemu-oracle-idp) as Listen evidence for: a listener started after sign-out is refused (initial-unauthenticated-refusal; rows n-out/listen-signed-out and b-out/listen-signed-out), another principal's listener on a private document is refused (cross-principal-rules; rows n-ab/as-alice, n-ab/after-switch and the b-ab rows), and a native gRPC Listen resumed with the current token (raw-resume-token; row resume/open). Differences to state wherever the evidence is cited: project (idp, not query), Rules (the cross2 ruleset, not conformance/firestore.rules), principals made by the administrator, a state change in one client instead of two static clients, and the browser rows in the browser's default WebChannel mode.

productionPlan.projectSelectionReason: Owner OL-3 selected query/(default), deployed conformance/firestore.rules and existing Auth. Serialize with STORAGE and FUNCTIONS via shared lock.
productionPlan.browserWireBaselineExplanation: One local receipt per browser mode used 915 long-polling and 473 streaming WebChannel requests. Doubling their sum gives a 2776-request baseline for the proposed two recordings per mode; Node, Auth, Rules, setup and cleanup requests are additional.
productionPlan.additionalCorpusEstimate: ExistenceFilter/BloomFilter, backend-mediated cache, native target protocol, metadata changes, limitToLast and browser tab lifecycle remain unestimated until finite runners and controls are defined.
productionPlan.cleanup: Close every listener, client and browser process; conditionally delete owned conf_* documents and both throwaway accounts, then read back typed absence and preserve unknown resources for recovery. Deployed Rules are unchanged.
prerequisites: FS-DATA-WRITE closure and exclusive query/(default) scheduling with STORAGE and FUNCTIONS
Migrate the catalog and all local adapters to conf_listen and conf_rules_owner without changing deployed Rules; preserve historical receipts
Production-capable source-bound SDK and browser adapters with all-wire accounting and finite request cap
Finite native target, cache, ExistenceFilter, metadata and limitToLast corpus with local shadow and clean-context review
Twice-recorded sandbox packet, JSONL ledger admission and owner permission
productionPlan.nativeProjectReason: L7: native gRPC Listen with the owner access token needs no Rules and costs nothing on the unbilled txn project.

note: The shared 18-case catalog uses case IDs as recipe IDs; 15 belong to this parent and 106, 109 and 109C belong to AUTH-FS-CROSS under R2. Additional recipes use fs-listen-sdk/<condition>.
